**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**

**5. US vs Global?**

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Mixed speculative tone: IBIT CORRECTION (1W: -3.07% | 1M: +7.81%) and ARKK CORRECTION (1W: -2.36% | 1M: +5.75%) show 1M gains with 1W pullbacks while IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.86% | 1M: -5.41%) signals small-cap fragility.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodity bifurcation: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.45% | 1M: +14.12%) ↑ rising while GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -4.29% | 1M: -6.36%) ↓ falling and SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -8.64% | 1M: -7.56%) weak.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.45% | 1M: +14.12%) ↑ rising vs XLE BELOW TREND (1W: -0.39% | 1M: -1.24%) → flat; UNG CORRECTION (1W: -4.70% | 1M: +0.19%) shows gas volatility.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: Commodities strength via BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.45% | 1M: +14.12%) and bond-duration selling via TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -4.31% | 1M: -5.25%) are independent confirms; MINOR Divergence observed across multiple CORRECTION-pattern ETFs (SOXX, IBIT, ARKK, XLK) but no MAJOR divergence across core SPY/XLK/XLF/TLT set.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor commodities exposure (BNO ABOVE TREND) and monitor credit/bond stress (HYG/LQD BELOW TREND); reduce exposure to clearly below-trend sector pockets (XLB BELOW TREND, XME BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy/Commodities via BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.45% | 1M: +14.12%). BEARISH: Materials XLB BELOW TREND (1W: -2.83% | 1M: -7.25%) and Mining XME BELOW TREND (1W: -7.18% | 1M: -12.44%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Brent (BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.45% | 1M: +14.12%)) and broad commodity ETFs PDBC CORRECTION (1W: -1.39% | 1M: +3.81%). BEARISH: Silver SLV BELOW TREND (1W: -8.64% | 1M: -7.56%) and Uranium URA BELOW TREND (1W: -8.46% | 1M: -12.14%).

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD 0.80 (credit health), XLK/XLF 2.0 (growth vs value pivot), SPY technical support zone from recent 1M moves.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive.  
Commodities (BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.45% | 1M: +14.12%)) and Healthcare (XLV RECOVERY (1W: +0.71% | 1M: -0.96%)) showing relative strength.  
Key risk: rising credit and duration stress (HYG/LQD BELOW TREND; TLT BELOW TREND) with multiple 1W pullbacks inside 1M gains—monitor volatility/credit signals.
